description: Open Street Map (OSM) is a dataset listed in OpenDataScienceEurope, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by planet.openstreetmap.org. OpenStreetMap (OSM) is a collaborative project to create a free editable map of the world. OSM is considered a prominent example of volunteered geographic information. Data are collected using manual survey, GPS devices, aerial photography, and other free sources. This crowdsourced data are then made available under the Open Database License. Coverage: Europe. Its keywords include World, osm, MOOD-H2020. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/LimitationsOnPublicAccess/noLimitations). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-opendatascienceeurope.
